core_claim.P: calling ln() with a negative input whose sign bit (MANTISSA_SIGN_MASK) is set
core_claim.I: ln() must reject negative inputs because the natural logarithm is undefined for negative real numbers
core_claim.V: ln() does not check the sign bit and silently processes negative inputs, returning an invalid result instead of reverting

distinct_impacts.description: ln() returns an invalid/incorrect result for negative inputs instead of reverting, breaking mathematical correctness
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: the function silently processes the input, returning an invalid result

distinct_impacts.description: Negative values bypass validation because the sign bit is not checked and masks exclude it
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: The `ln()` function does not check if the input's sign bit (`MANTISSA_SIGN_MASK`) is set. This omission allows negative values to bypass validation.
